<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getlanguage" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getLanguage</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the client's preferred language</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getLanguage</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the client's preferred language</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The preferred language string, or &null; if it cannot be determined.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getLanguage</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        // Assuming the client sends "Accept-Language: zh-CN"
        $language = $this->getRequest()->getLanguage();

        var_dump($language);
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(5) "zh-CN"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getServer</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getEnv</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getmethod" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getMethod</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the request method</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getMethod</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the request method</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The request method as a string, e.g. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getMethod</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class OrderController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function saveAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        // Assuming the request was sent with POST /order/save
        var_dump($request->getMethod());
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(4) "POST"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getparam" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve a parameter</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a parameter (a named routing/action parameter) from the request.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The parameter name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the parameter is not set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The parameter value, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it was provided, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function viewAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        // Assuming the request is /product/view/id/17
        $id       = (int) $request->getParam("id");
        $referrer = $request->getParam("referrer", "direct");

        var_dump($id, $referrer);
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
int(17)
string(6) "direct"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParams</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::clearParams</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getpost" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getPost</refname>
<refpurpose>Fetch a POST parameter</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getPost</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from $_POST.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name. If omitted, the whole array is returned.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The POST parameter value, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it is not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getPost</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class LoginController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        // Assuming the form was submitted with POST /login
        if ($this->getRequest()->isPost()) {
            $username = $this->getRequest()->getPost("username");
            $remember = $this->getRequest()->getPost("remember", "no");

            var_dump($username, $remember);
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(8) "laruence"
string(3) "yes"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

  &reftitle.seealso;

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getRequest</methodname></member>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.isdispatched" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isDispatched</refname>
<refpurpose>Determine if the request is dispatched</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isDispatched</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Determine whether the request has been dispatched.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the request has been dispatched, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isDispatched</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        // Stop the dispatch loop, no further action will be dispatched
        $this->getRequest()->setDispatched();

        var_dump($this->getRequest()->isDispatched());
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

    {

<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isOptions</refname>
<refpurpose>Determine if the request is a OPTIONS request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isOptions</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether the request was sent with the OPTIONS method.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the request method is OPTIONS, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isOptions</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function corsAction()
    {
        // Assuming the browser sends a CORS preflight request
        if ($this->getRequest()->isOptions()) {
            $this->getResponse()
                 ->setHeader("Allow", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
                 ->setBody("");
            return false;
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.isrouted" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</refname>
<refpurpose>Determine if the request has been routed</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Determine whether the request has been routed.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the request has been routed, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        // Skip if another router already routed this request
        if ($request->isRouted()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api/")) {
            $request->setControllerName("Api")
                    ->setActionName("handle");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::route</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.isxmlhttprequest" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isXmlHttpRequest</refname>
<refpurpose>Determine if the request is an Ajax request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isXmlHttpRequest</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether the request is an Ajax request by inspecting the HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH request header.</simpara>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    <classname>Yaf_Request_Simple</classname> overrides this method and always
    returns &false;, since command-line requests are never Ajax requests.
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the request is an Ajax request (the <literal>X-Requested-With</literal> header equals <literal>XMLHttpRequest</literal>), &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isXmlHttpRequest</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function viewAction()
    {
        // Assuming the request carries "X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest"
        if ($this->getRequest()->isXmlHttpRequest()) {
            $this->getResponse()
                 ->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
                 ->setBody(json_encode(["id" => 17, "name" => "Yaf in Action"]));
            return false;
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
{"id":17,"name":"Yaf in Action"}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

  &reftitle.seealso;

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isPost</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isPut</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isHead</methodname></member>

  </simplelist>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setactionname" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set action name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>format_name</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   set action name to request, this is usually used by custom router to set route result action name.
  </simpara>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>action</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      &string;, action name, it should in lower case style, like "index" or "foo_bar" 
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>format_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      this is introduced in Yaf 3.2.0, by default Yaf will format the name into lower case style,
      if this is set to &false; , Yaf will set the original name to request.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the request object itself on success, or &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RestRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        // Route any /api request to ApiController::ordersAction
        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api")) {
            $request->setControllerName("Api")
                    ->setActionName("orders");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getActionName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setbaseuri" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set base URI</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>uir</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Set base URI, base URI is used when doing routing, in routing phase request
   URI is used to route a request,  while base URI is used to skip the
   leading part(base URI) of request URI.

   That is, if comes a request with request URI a/b/c, then if you set base
   URI to "a/b", only "/c" will be used in routing phase.
   <note>
    <simpara>
     generally, you don't need to set this, Yaf will determine it automatically.
    </simpara>
   </note>
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>uir</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
       base URI
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>Returns the request object itself on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("GET", "Index", "Product", "View");

// The application lives under /myapp,
// requests come in as /myapp/product/view
$request->setBaseUri("/myapp");
$request->setRequestUri("/myapp/product/view");

var_dump($request->getBaseUri());
var_dump($request->getRequestUri());
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(6) "/myapp"
string(19) "/myapp/product/view"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getBaseUri</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getRequestUri</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setcontrollername" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>

 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>format_name</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    set controller name to request, this is usually used by custom router to set route result controller name.
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>controller</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      &string;, controller name, this should be in camel style, like "Index" or "Foo_Bar" 
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>format_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      this is introduced in Yaf 3.2.0, by default Yaf will format the name into camel mode,
      if this is set to &false; , Yaf will set the original name to request.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the request object itself on success, or &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RestRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api")) {
            // Names are formatted to camel style by default,
            // so "order_item" becomes "Order_Item"
            $request->setControllerName("order_item")
                    ->setActionName("list");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setdispatched" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</refname>
<refpurpose>Mark the request as dispatched</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>final</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Mark the request as dispatched</simpara>
  <simpara>This is called by the dispatcher after an action is executed; it stops the dispatch loop. It can be called manually, e.g. to skip the remaining dispatch iterations.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The state to set. Defaults to &true;.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setDispatched</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AuthPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        if (empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
            // Skip the requested action and redirect to the login page
            $request->setDispatched();
            $response->setRedirect("/account/login");
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isDispatched</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setmodulename" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set module name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>format_name</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    set module name to request, this is usually used by custom router to set route result module name.
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>module</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      &string; module name, it should be in camel style, like "Index" or "Foo_Bar"   
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>format_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      this is introduced in Yaf 3.2.0, by default Yaf will format the name into camel mode,
      if this is set to &false; , Yaf will set the original name to request.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the request object itself on success, or &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AdminRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        // Serve everything under /admin from the Admin module
        if (0 === strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/admin")) {
            $request->setModuleName("Admin")
                    ->setControllerName("Dashboard")
                    ->setActionName("index");
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getModuleName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setparam" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</refname>
<refpurpose>Set a parameter to the request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Set a parameter to the request, which can be retrieved by <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>.</simpara>
  <simpara>If called with a single array argument, every key/value pair is set as a parameter.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The parameter name, or an array of key/value pairs.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The parameter value. Required unless <parameter>name</parameter> is an array.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        $request->setParam("referrer", "newsletter");
        $request->setParam(["source" => "email", "campaign" => "spring"]);

        var_dump($request->getParam("referrer"));
        var_dump($request->getParams());
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(10) "newsletter"
array(3) {
  ["referrer"]=>
  string(10) "newsletter"
  ["source"]=>
  string(5) "email"
  ["campaign"]=>
  string(6) "spring"
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParams</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::clearParams</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setrequesturi" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</refname>
<refpurpose>Set the request URI</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>uri</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Set the request URI, overriding the one detected from the environment.</simpara>
  <simpara>This is useful when dispatching manually, e.g. in tests, with a URI that differs from the real one.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>uri</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The request URI to set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRequestUri</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI", "Index", "Index", "Index");

// Dispatch manually against a URI that differs from the real one
$request->setRequestUri("/product/view/id/17");

var_dump($request->getRequestUri());
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(19) "/product/view/id/17"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getRequestUri</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setBaseUri</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getBaseUri</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.setrouted" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</refname>
<refpurpose>Mark the request as routed</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>final</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>true</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Mark the request as routed</simpara>
  <simpara>This is called by the router once routing has succeeded. Calling it manually can prevent custom routers from being run afterwards.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The state to set. Defaults to &true;.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiRouter extends Yaf_Route_Interface
{
    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request)
    {
        if (0 !== strpos($request->getRequestUri(), "/api/")) {
            return false;
        }

        $request->setControllerName("Api")
                ->setActionName("handle");

        // Prevent routers registered after this one from running
        $request->setRouted();

        return true;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, array $query = null) {}
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::isRouted</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::route</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?php
/**
 * Build a http request explicitly with an URI and a base URI.
 *
 * If the request URI is omitted, it is retrieved from the usual
 * $_SERVER variables ($_SERVER["PATH_INFO"], $_SERVER["REQUEST_URI"], ...).
 */

var_dump($request->getMethod());
var_dump($request->getRequestUri());
var_dump($request->getBaseUri());
?>
]]>

 <refsect1 role="description">

   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Simple::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * In a CLI script, build a request that skips the routing
 * process by giving the MVC names directly.
 */
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple(
    "CLI",            // method
    "Index",          // module
    "Product",        // controller
    "detail",         // action
    array("id" => 10) // request parameters
);

var_dump($request->isRouted()); /* requests with MVC names are pre-routed */
var_dump($request->getModuleName());
var_dump($request->getControllerName());
var_dump($request->getActionName());
var_dump($request->getParam("id"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
string(5) "Index"
string(7) "Product"
string(6) "detail"
int(10)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.clearbody" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</refname>
<refpurpose>Discard all existing response bodies</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>false</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>key</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Discard all existing response bodies.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>key</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The content key. If specified, only that content block is cleared; otherwise, all content blocks are cleared.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the response object itself on success, or &null; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $response = $this->getResponse();

        $response->setBody("Hello", "intro");
        $response->setBody("World");

        $response->clearBody("intro"); // drop only the "intro" block
        var_dump($response->getBody(null));

        $response->clearBody(); // drop every body block
        var_dump($response->getBody(null));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(1) {
  ["content"]=>
  string(5) "World"
}
array(0) {
}]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setBody</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::appendBody</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::prependBody</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getBody</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.clearheaders" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearHeaders</refname>
<refpurpose>Remove all response headers</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>false</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearHeaders</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Remove all HTTP response headers that have been set.</simpara>
  <note><simpara>This method is only fully implemented in the <classname>Yaf_Response_Http</classname> subclass. In the abstract class it is a stub.</simpara></note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the response object itself on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearHeaders</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $response = $this->getResponse();

        $response->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
        $response->clearHeaders();

        var_dump($response->getHeader()); // array(0) { }
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setHeader</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getHeader</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setAllHeaders</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Construct a response</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Construct a response object. The constructor takes no arguments; the
   concrete subclasses like <classname>Yaf_Response_Http</classname> and
   <classname>Yaf_Response_Cli</classname> initialize their own defaults
   (an HTTP response starts with the <literal>200</literal> response code,
   for example).
  </simpara>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    Usually a response object does not need to be constructed manually:
    <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname> returns the one
    created by the dispatcher.
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   No value is returned.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* usually there is no need to construct a response manually:
 * the dispatcher creates one and hands it out */
$response = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getResponse();

/* constructing directly is mostly useful in tests */
$response = new Yaf_Response_Http();
$response->setBody("Hello World");

echo $response;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Hello World]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::response</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.getbody" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getBody</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve a response body block</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getBody</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>key</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the content of a response body block.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>key</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The content key. If not specified, the DEFAULT_BODY block is used; pass &null; to get all content blocks as an array.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The content string, or an array of all content blocks when <parameter>key</parameter> is &null;. Returns an empty string if the block is not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getBody</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$response = new Yaf_Response_Http();

$response->setBody("Hello")->setBody(" World", "footer");

var_dump($response->getBody());
var_dump($response->getBody(Yaf_Response_Abstract::DEFAULT_BODY));
var_dump($response->getBody("footer"));
var_dump($response->getBody(NULL));
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(5) "Hello"
string(5) "Hello"
string(6) " World"
array(2) {
  ["content"]=>
  string(5) "Hello"
  ["footer"]=>
  string(6) " World"
}]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setBody</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::appendBody</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::prependBody</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearBody</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getHeader</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve an HTTP response header</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getHeader</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve an HTTP response header.</simpara>
  <note><simpara>This method is only fully implemented in the <classname>Yaf_Response_Http</classname> subclass. In the abstract class it is a stub.</simpara></note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The header name. If omitted, all headers are returned as an array.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The header value as a string, or an array of all headers when the name is omitted. Returns &null; if the requested header is not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getHeader</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $response = $this->getResponse();
        $response->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");

        var_dump($response->getHeader("Content-Type"));
        var_dump($response->getHeader()); // all headers
        var_dump($response->getHeader("X-Missing"));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(16) "application/json"
array(1) {
  ["Content-Type"]=>
  string(16) "application/json"
}
NULL]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setHeader</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearHeaders</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setAllHeaders</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.setallheaders" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setAllHeaders</refname>
<refpurpose>Set all HTTP response headers</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setAllHeaders</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>headers</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Set all HTTP response headers at once.</simpara>
  <note><simpara>This method is only fully implemented in the <classname>Yaf_Response_Http</classname> subclass. In the abstract class it is a stub.</simpara></note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>headers</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>An array of header name/value pairs. Any existing header with the same name is replaced.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true;.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setAllHeaders</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $this->getResponse()->setAllHeaders(array(
            "Content-Type"  => "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            "Cache-Control" => "no-cache",
            "X-Request-Id"  => "7f3c2d91",
        ));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setHeader</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getHeader</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearHeaders</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-response-abstract.setheader" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setHeader</refname>
<refpurpose>Set an HTTP response header</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setHeader</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>replace</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>int</type><parameter>response_code</parameter><initializer>0</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Set an HTTP response header.</simpara>
  <note><simpara>This method is only fully implemented in the <classname>Yaf_Response_Http</classname> subclass. In the abstract class it is a stub.</simpara></note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The header name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The header value.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>replace</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>Whether to replace any existing header with the same name. If &false;, the new value is appended to the existing one, separated by a comma. Note that, although the declared default is &false;, the current implementation replaces the existing header when this parameter is omitted.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response_code</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>If non-zero, the HTTP response code to set on the response.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setHeader</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $response = $this->getResponse();

        $response->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");

        /* send a 401 and ask for credentials */
        $response->setHeader("WWW-Authenticate", 'Basic realm="Member Area"', true, 401);
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::getHeader</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::clearHeaders</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setAllHeaders</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setRedirect</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>url</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Redirect the client to another URL (sends a Location header).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>url</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The URL to redirect to.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success, or &null; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setRedirect</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AccountController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        if (!Yaf_Session::getInstance()->has("login")) {
            /* send a Location header pointing to the login page */
            $this->getResponse()->setRedirect("/account/login");
            return false; // nothing to render here
        }
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

   <programlisting role="php">

$response->setBody("Hello")->setBody(" World", "footer");

?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-interface.assemble" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</refname>
  <refpurpose>Assemble a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>abstract</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>string</type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>info</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>array</type><parameter>query</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   this method returns a url according to the argument info, and append
   query strings to the url according to the argument query.
  </para>
  <para>
   a route should implement this method according to its own route rules, and
   do a reverse progress.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>info</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
     
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>

   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>query</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>

     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RewriteRoute implements Yaf_Route_Interface {

    private $_match;
    private $_route;

    public function __construct(string $match, array $route) {
        $this->_match = $match;
        $this->_route = $route;
    }

    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request): bool {
        if (!preg_match($this->_match, $request->getRequestUri(), $matches)) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($this->_route as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value) && ':' === $value[0]) {
                $value = $matches[substr($value, 1)];
            }
            $request->setParam($key, $value);
        }
        $request->setRouted();

        return true;
    }

    /* reverse the route rules back into a URL */
    public function assemble(array $info, ?array $query = null): string {
        $url = "/product";
        if (isset($info[':name'])) {
            $url .= "/" . $info[':name'];
        }

        if (!empty($query)) {
            $url .= "?" . http_build_query($query);
        }

        return $url;
    }
}

$router = new Yaf_Router();
$router->addRoute("custom",
    new RewriteRoute("#^/product#", array("controller" => "product"))
);

var_dump($router->getRoute("custom")->assemble(
    array(':name' => 'book'),
    array('page' => 2)
));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(20) "/product/book?page=2"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Rewrite::assemble</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::assemble</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-interface.route" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</refname>
  <refpurpose>Route a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>abstract</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    <methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</methodname> is the only method
    that a custom route should implement.
    <note>
     <simpara>
      since of 2.3.0, there is another method should also be implemented,
      see <methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </note>
  </para>
  <para>
    if this method return &true;, then the route process will be end. otherwise,
    <classname>Yaf_Router</classname> will call next route in the route stack
    to route request.
  </para>

  <para>
    This method would set the route result to the parameter request, by
    calling <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setControllerName</methodname>,
    <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setActionName</methodname> and
    <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setModuleName</methodname>.
   </para>

   <para>
    This method should also call
    <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname> to make the
    request routed at last.
   </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
       A <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiRoute implements Yaf_Route_Interface {

    private $_prefix;

    public function __construct(string $prefix) {
        $this->_prefix = $prefix;
    }

    public function route(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request): bool {
        $uri = $request->getRequestUri();
        if (0 !== strpos($uri, $this->_prefix)) {
            /* not our business, let the router try the next route */
            return false;
        }

        /* parse the URI "/api/user/list" into controller/action */
        $segments = explode("/", ltrim(substr($uri, strlen($this->_prefix)), "/"));
        $controller = isset($segments[0]) ? ucfirst($segments[0]) : NULL;
        $action = isset($segments[1]) ? $segments[1] : NULL;

        if (empty($controller)) {
            return false;
        }

        $request->setModuleName("index");
        $request->setControllerName($controller);
        $request->setActionName($action);
        $request->setRouted(); /* the route process ends here */

        return true;
    }

    public function assemble(array $info, ?array $query = null): string {
        $uri = $this->_prefix . "/" . strtolower($info[':c']);
        if (isset($info[':a'])) {
            $uri .= "/" . $info[':a'];
        }

        if (!empty($query)) {
            $uri .= "?" . http_build_query($query);
        }

        return $uri;
    }
}

/**
 * register the custom route
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute("api", new ApiRoute("/api"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/* http://yourdomain.com/api/user/list
 * routes to the following values:
 */
array(
  "module"     => "index",
  "controller" => "User",
  "action"     => "list",
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Interface::assemble</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::addRoute</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setRouted</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<![CDATA[
<?php

$router = new Yaf_Router();

$route  = new Yaf_Route_Map();

$router->addRoute("map", $route);

var_dump($router->getRoute('map')->assemble(
                        array(
                                ':c' => 'foo_bar'
                        ),
                        array(
                                'tkey1' => 'tval1',
                                'tkey2' => 'tval2'
                        )
                   )
);

$route = new Yaf_Route_Map(true, '_');
$router->addRoute("map", $route);

var_dump($router->getRoute('map')->assemble(
                        array(
                                ':a' => 'foo_bar'
                        ),
                        array(
                                'tkey1' => 'tval1',
                                'tkey2' => 'tval2'
                        )
                   )
);
]]>

]]>
   </screen>
  </example>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-map.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Route_Map::__construct</refname>
<refpurpose>Construct a map route</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::__construct</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>controller_prefer</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>delimiter</parameter><initializer>''</initializer></methodparam>
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>Construct a map route. A map route maps the whole URI to a controller name or an action name.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>controller_prefer</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>Whether to map the URI to a controller name. If &false;, the URI is mapped to an action name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>delimiter</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The delimiter used to separate the mapped name from the request parameters in the URI. If it occurs as a path segment preceded by a slash, everything after it is parsed as request parameters instead of being part of the mapped name. If empty, no such splitting happens during routing.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Map</classname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Add a map route to the Yaf_Router route stack
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute("name",
    new Yaf_Route_Map());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/* for http://yourdomain.com/product/foo/bar
 * the request will carry the following values:
 */
array(
  "action" => "product_foo_bar",
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Map</classname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Add a map route with a delimiter to the Yaf_Router route stack
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute("name",
    new Yaf_Route_Map(true, "_"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/* for http://yourdomain.com/user/list/_/foo/22
 * the request will carry the following values:
 */
array(
    "controller" => "User_List",
)

/**
 * and request parameters:
 */
array(
  "foo" => "22",
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Map</classname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Add a map route to the route stack by calling addConfig
 */
$config = array(
    "name" => array(
       "type"             => "map", // Yaf_Route_Map route
       "controllerPrefer" => FALSE,
       "delimiter"        => "#!",
    ),
);
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addConfig(
    new Yaf_Config_Simple($config));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-map.route" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</refname>
<refpurpose>Route a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Route the request by mapping the whole URI to a controller name or an action name: the path segments of the URI are joined with underscores to form the name.</simpara>
  <simpara>When the route was constructed with the controller prefer flag on, the result is set as the controller name, otherwise as the action name.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance to route.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Always returns &true;. Note that the map route claims the request even when the URI is empty, in which case no name is set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI");
$request->setRequestUri("/product/foo/bar");

$route = new Yaf_Route_Map();
var_dump($route->route($request));
var_dump($request->getActionName());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
string(15) "product_foo_bar"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::route</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI");
$request->setRequestUri("/user/list/_/foo/22");

$route = new Yaf_Route_Map(true, "_");
var_dump($route->route($request));
var_dump($request->getControllerName());
var_dump($request->getParam("foo"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
string(9) "User_List"
string(2) "22"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::__construct</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Map::assemble</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-regex.assemble" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Route_Regex::assemble</refname>
  <refpurpose>Assemble a url</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::assemble</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>info</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>array</type><parameter>query</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Assemble a url.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>info</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>query</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   Returns &string; on success or &null; on failure.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Route_Regex::assemble</function>example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$router = new Yaf_Router();

$route  = new Yaf_Route_Regex(
            "#^/product/([^/]+)/([^/])+#",
            array(
                'controller' => "product",  //route to product controller,
                ),
            array(),
            array(),
            '/:m/:c/:a'
        );

$router->addRoute("regex", $route);

var_dump($router->getRoute('regex')->assemble(
            array(
                ':m' => 'module',
                ':c' => 'controller',
                ':a' => 'action'
                ),
            array(
                'tkey1' => 'tval1',
                'tkey2' =>
                'tval2'
                )
            )
        );
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(49) "/module/controller/action?tkey1=tval1&tkey2=tval2"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-route-regex.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Route_Regex::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Yaf_Route_Regex constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::__construct</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>match</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>route</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>map</parameter><initializer>&null;</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>verify</parameter><initializer>&null;</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>reverse</parameter><initializer>&null;</initializer></methodparam>
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Constructs a <classname>Yaf_Route_Regex</classname> route, which routes a
   request URI matching a regular expression to a module, controller and action.
  </simpara>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>match</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A complete regular expression pattern, used to match the request URI.
      When it does not match, <methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::route</methodname>
      returns &false; and the router moves on to the next route.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>route</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      When the pattern matches the request URI, this &array; determines the
      module, controller and action to route to.
     </simpara>
     <simpara>
      Each of the three entries is optional; when one is not given, the
      default is used. An entry whose value starts with <literal>:</literal>
      is resolved against the parameters produced by
      <parameter>map</parameter>.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>map</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      An &array; mapping capture group indexes to parameter names. Only the
      captures listed here become request parameters; a numeric capture that
      is not listed is discarded.
     </simpara>
     <simpara>
      Named capture groups are always added under their own name and do not
      need to be listed.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>verify</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Accepted and stored on the route, but not used: the current
      implementation never consults it while routing.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>reverse</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      A &string;, used to assemble URL, see
      <methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::assemble</methodname>.
      <note>
       <simpara>
        This parameter is introduced in 2.3.0
       </simpara>
      </note>
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Regex</classname> via <methodname>Yaf_Router::addRoute</methodname></title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

/**
 * Add a regex route to the Yaf_Router route stack
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute(
    "name",
    new Yaf_Route_Regex(
        "#^/product/([^/]+)/([^/]+)#", // match a URI leading "/product"
        array(
            'controller' => "product", // route to the product controller
        ),
        array(
            1 => "name", // $request->getParam("name") holds the first capture
            2 => "id",   // and $request->getParam("id") the second
        )
    )
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Regex</classname> using a capture as the controller name</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

/**
 * Use a capture as the controller name
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute(
    "name",
    new Yaf_Route_Regex(
        "#^/product/([^/]+)/([^/]+)#i", // match a URI leading "/product"
        array(
            'controller' => ":name", // the "name" capture (see map) becomes the controller
        ),
        array(
            1 => "name", // $request->getParam("name") holds the first capture
            2 => "id",   // and $request->getParam("id") the second
        )
    )
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Regex</classname> using a named capture group</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

/**
 * Use a named capture group as the controller name
 */
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addRoute(
    "name",
    new Yaf_Route_Regex(
        "#^/product/(?<name>[^/]+)/([^/]+)#i", // match a URI leading "/product"
        array(
            'controller' => ":name", // the "name" capture becomes the controller
        ),
        array(
            2 => "id", // group 1 is named, only group 2 needs a map entry
        )
    )
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Route_Regex</classname> via <methodname>Yaf_Router::addConfig</methodname></title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

/**
 * Add a regex route to the Yaf_Router route stack through a config array
 */
$config = array(
    "name" => array(
        "type"  => "regex",          // a Yaf_Route_Regex route
        "match" => "#(.*)#",         // match any request URI
        "route" => array(
            'controller' => "product", // route to the product controller
            'action'     => "dummy",   // and to the dummy action
        ),
        "map" => array(
            1 => "uri", // $request->getParam("uri") holds the matched URI
        ),
    ),
);

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRouter()->addConfig(
    new Yaf_Config_Simple($config)
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::route</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Route_Regex::assemble</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::addRoute</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Router::addConfig</methodname></member>
   <member><classname>Yaf_Route_Static</classname></member>
   <member><classname>Yaf_Route_Supervar</classname></member>
   <member><classname>Yaf_Route_Simple</classname></member>
   <member><classname>Yaf_Route_Rewrite</classname></member>
   <member><classname>Yaf_Route_Map</classname></member>
  </simplelist>                       
 </refsect1>  

</refentry>
